description: Best for: finding jobs by title or skill across the open feeds (JobTech Sweden, CC0; Remote OK; Canada Job Bank, OGL-Canada) when no specific company is named. Returns: job rows (title, company, locations, remote, posted_at, apply link, source), at most 50 per page (page_size, default 10) and one page only: there is no next page, and extra.matched counts every match; data_job_details gives one board posting's full text. Input tips: on a company board every q word must appear in the title, company or department, while each feed matches q its own way (some also read the ad text); location (every word must be a whole word of the posting's place, such as Toronto or Sweden), remote (true for remote only, false to leave remote out) and posted_within_days filter the results; company reads one Greenhouse, Lever or Ashby board only (an ats:slug token such as greenhouse:airbnb, a board address, or a name tried on all three) and returns only that one page of its matches. Not for: a complete list of a named company's open roles (use list_jobs, which has title filters, covers many more hiring systems and returns up to 1000 jobs per company by default). Costs 1 credit for a company board, else 1 per feed read (3). Every row has name (platform/collection/id), kind, its fields and source {platform, url, license, attribution, fetched_at, terms_url}; quote source.attribution when you show a row.

company.description: Optional: one company's board, as greenhouse:airbnb, lever:spotify, ashby:notion, a board address or a company name.

location.description: Optional place words, such as Toronto, Stockholm or Canada.

posted_within_days.description: Optional: only postings first published this many days back or less.

q.description: Job title or skill words, such as "data engineer". On a company board every word must appear in the title, company or department; each feed matches q its own way (some also read the ad text).

remote.description: Optional: true for remote jobs only, false to leave remote jobs out.

name: data_search_jobs
title: Search job postings
